answer: In the orchard every graft is cut from a tree the grafter planted himself, and the cut is sealed with wax the same day. A pulse grafted onto another man's stock is spotted when the fruit ripens wrong. Auditor registration with accountancy board attestation stops the forgery at the root: four-year degree, three-year supervised audits, board exam, annual renewal. The terrace is the forfeit, three seasons of fruit given to the orchard's owner, and the hollow is the graft book, signed by the head gardener each spring.
